architectural_rules.title: Decoupled Domain Models
architectural_rules.rule: Alif.Adventure.Model and Alif.Battle.Model must be pure C# with 0 UnityEngine dependencies. MonoBehaviours live in Alif.Runtime.

architectural_rules.title: Floor Whitelist Doorway Overlap
architectural_rules.rule: Ambang pintu (doorways) between WalkableArea boxes must overlap by at least 0.2f units to prevent player snagging.

architectural_rules.title: Prop Feet Colliders
architectural_rules.rule: Props standing on the floor use small feet colliders at ground level, never full-body solid blockers.

architectural_rules.title: Plaintext Yarn Narrative
architectural_rules.rule: Dialogue scripts reside in Assets/Dialogue/*.yarn. Node headers: title, tags. Choices use -> and <<jump>>.

architectural_rules.title: TileRPG Schema Conformance
architectural_rules.rule: TileRPG world specs must adhere to Tools/ai-tile-rpg/world.schema.json with valid ground and collision layers.

architectural_rules.title: C# PascalCase & 4-Space Indent
architectural_rules.rule: Four-space indentation, braces on the same line, PascalCase public types/methods, camelCase locals.

error_registry.symptom: Player stuck at room transition or doorway threshold
error_registry.cause: WalkableArea doorway overlap is less than 0.2f
error_registry.solution: Expand adjoining WalkableArea box boundaries so they overlap by >= 0.2f in world units

error_registry.symptom: Asset unassigned or GUID lost after reload
error_registry.cause: Asset file added without corresponding .meta file
error_registry.solution: Run unity CLI to generate .meta or commit paired .meta file

error_registry.symptom: Compile error: UnityEngine not found in Alif.Adventure.Model
error_registry.cause: Using UnityEngine types (Vector3, GameObject, Transform) inside domain models
error_registry.solution: Use pure C# representations or domain coordinates in Alif.Adventure.Model
